messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we finished the customer interview with FoxTrail. Need three things before publish: 1) signed consent, 2) an approved short quote for the launch post, 3) final transcript + 2 soundbite options. Target publish: Wed morning. Notes & raw audio: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/foxtrail-interview :sparkles:

Jonah: Nice. Can we get the quote by EOD tomorrow? I'll draft a couple variants for approval.

Priya: Yep. Which angle are we prioritizing — cost savings or developer velocity?

Sam (CS): Customer emphasized cost and latency wins. They said: "Redwood cut inference costs by 3x" in the call, but asked to anonymize competitor baselines.

Maria: Ok — prioritize a cost-focused pull quote plus a dev-ex speed line as backup. Priya, please paste both options into the content doc.

Priya: Done — pasted two variants in the doc: 
> "Redwood reduced our token costs by 3x while keeping 95th‑percentile latency under 60ms."
> "With Redwood we shipped a conversational feature in two weeks using the API and dedicated pool."

Lexa (Legal): Heads-up — we need the signed customer consent form that explicitly allows the quote and a short approval email. I uploaded a redlined consent template: https://drive.google.com/open?id=consent-redline — sec 2b restricts raw competitor naming.

Maria: @Lexa how fast can legal sign off if we use anonymized numbers? Also, can we accept a quote that uses "~3x" instead of exact numbers?

Lexa (Legal): If they want anonymized metrics, we can use approximations ("~3x"). That avoids sharing baselines. If they insist on a named comparison, we need explicit sign-off and the customer must confirm accuracy in writing. I can draft the approval email template to send to them.

Jonah: I'll send the approval request now and cc @Lexa. @Sam can you DM the customer's contact email?

Sam (CS): Sent to foxtrail-poc@foxtrail.io and cc'd their product lead. They replied: "Happy to approve the first quote with anonymized metrics — please use '~3x' and remove competitor names." They attached a signed consent PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/foxtrail-consent.pdf

Transcript Bot: Transcript uploaded: /files/1756789012-foxtrail-interview.txt

Maria: Great — signed consent received and legal ok for anonymized numbers. Next: marketing needs the final quote by tomorrow noon. Jonah + Priya to finalize wording and mark the approved variant in the doc.

Priya: Working on final language now. Will paste final by 12pm.

Jonah: Shared final text in doc and pinged Lexa: "Redwood reduced token costs ~3x while preserving developer velocity." Lexa — please confirm.

Lexa (Legal): Approved. You can use: "Redwood reduced our token costs ~3x while preserving developer velocity."

Maria: :tada: Excellent. I'll schedule the short launch post for Wed AM and create the assets (social copy, blog excerpt, quote graphic). @Sam please set up inbound lead routing for any signups after the post (SDR queue).

Sam (CS): Confirmed — I'll add a HubSpot rule: tag = case-study/FoxTrail, owner = FoxTrail SDR queue. Also will attach the consent PDF and transcript to the contact record.

Maria: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: consent PDF uploaded, transcript + audio trimmed, quote graphic mock in /marketing/assets/, blog draft ready for review. Closing thread once assets are in GDrive.

Priya: Uploaded quote graphic draft to the folder and added alt copy.

Jonah: I updated the content calendar slot and scheduled the internal launch email to Sales for Wed 9am.

Maria: Perfect. I'll post the live launch once assets are staged and Sales is notified. Closing out — great work!"
